name: Billard im Gärkeller
kurzbeschreibung: Billards in the Gärkeller in Innsbruck – enjoy a game in the historic cellar of the Brauhaus Tyrol with a cold Tiroler Bier in hand.
beschreibung: Billard im Gärkeller in Innsbruck is a stylish bar and recreation venue that pairs billiard tables with an inviting lounge atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a wide selection of drinks including draft beers, cocktails, and fine spirits while playing a round of pool. The interior blends historic cellar vaulting with modern lighting and comfortable seating. An ideal spot for an entertaining evening with friends or a lively get-together after work in Innsbruck.
